# Intention, Application and Access to Early Childcare 
```{r}
library(fixest)
library(stringr)
library(broom)
# --- Data ---
df <- MainDB %>%
  mutate(
    Intention = ifelse(Intention == "Yes", 1, 0),
    Educ = relevel(factor(Educ), ref = "Sup")  # ou "Low-SES" selon tes modalités
  )
# --- One multi-outcome regression ---
m_gap <- feols(c(Intention, ECSApp, ECSUseYes) ~ Educ,
               data = df,
               se = "hetero")

# --- Extract estimates from modelplot (long format) ---
res <- modelplot(m_gap, draw = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome = str_remove(model, "lhs:"),
    OutcomeLabel = factor(case_when(
      str_detect(outcome, "Intention") ~ "Intend to use",
      str_detect(outcome, "ECSApp") ~ "Apply",
      str_detect(outcome, "ECSUseYes") ~ "Access",
      TRUE ~ outcome
    ), levels = c("Intend to use","Apply","Access"))
  )

# IMPORTANT: pick the coefficient that corresponds to the SES gap.
# Adjust the pattern to match your exact Educ2 term name in res$term
gap_df <- res %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "Educ")) %>%           # <- if multiple Educ2 terms exist, refine here
  # If you have e.g. "Educ2::Low-SES", use:
  # filter(term == "Educ2::Low-SES")
  transmute(
    OutcomeLabel,
    estimate_pp = 100 * estimate,
    conf.low_pp = 100 * conf.low,
    conf.high_pp = 100 * conf.high,
    label = sprintf("%+.1f pp", 100 * estimate)
  )

# --- Plot ---

p_gap_bar <- ggplot(gap_df,
                    aes(x = OutcomeLabel,
                        y = estimate_pp,
                        fill = OutcomeLabel)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low_pp, ymax = conf.high_pp),
                width = 0.18, linewidth = 0.6) +
  
  # --- BOXED LABELS ---
  geom_label(
    aes(label = label),
    vjust = ifelse(gap_df$estimate_pp < 0, 1.3, -0.3),
    size = 3.6,
    fontface = "bold",
    label.size = 0,          # no border
    fill = "grey",          # solid background
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.95,
    label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines")
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = cbPalette[2:4]) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "SES gap (percentage points)",
    caption = "Notes: SES gaps from bivariate linear probability models.\nError bars indicate 95% confidence intervals based on heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors. \nIntention to use is measured during pregnancy, while Application and Access are measured \none year after delivery."
  ) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  paper_theme

p_gap_bar

#width_in  <- 11 / 2.54  # 4.33 in
#height_in <- 11 / 2.54  # 4.33 in
#

#  width = width_in,
#  height = height_in,
#  units = "in",
#  dpi = 300              # ignored for PDF but OK to include
#)
#
```


# RFE

## Intention


```{r}
cleaned_variables_intention <- c("AccessInformalFullTime",
                         "WorkPlanTo",
                          "TrustEarlyChildcareAgree",
                        "ECAccessHoursFit",
                         "LevelInformation")         
```



```{r run_oaxaca_intention}

# Clean the names
coef_names <- c(  
  "NumberChildren" = "Household size (number of children)",
  "Taux.de.couv.global" = "Local early childcare availability",
  "ActiveYes" = "Pre-birth employment status",
  "WorkPlanToYes" = "Post-birth work intention",
  "ECAccessHoursFitYes" = "Compatibility of childcare opening hours",
  "AccessInformalFullTimeYes" = "Access to informal childcare arrangements",
  "OpportunityCosts" = "Opportunity costs of staying at home",
  "NegativeImpactSalaryYes" = "Perceived salary consequences of staying at home",
  "NegativeImpactCareerYes" = "Perceived career consequences of staying at home",
  "NegativeImpactWellBeingYes" = "Perceived well-being consequences of staying at home",
  "PrescriptiveNorm" = "Social opposition to maternal childcare use",
  "NormsUseMostToAllYes" = "Exposure to childcare use in social network",
  "AttitudesTowardsWorkAndFamilyYes" = "Gender role attitudes within the household",
  "AttitudesLaborAffectsChildrenYes" = "Beliefs about work and child development",
  "PerceivedAffordabilityOverestimate" = "Perceived affordability of early childcare (overestimation)",
  "PerceivedAffordabilityUnderestimate" = "Perceived affordability of early childcare (underestimation)",
  "TrustEarlyChildcareAgreeYes" = "Trust in early childcare institutions",
  "ECBenefitChildrenAgreeYes" = "Perceived benefits of early childcare for children",
  "LevelInformationLow knowledge" = "Level of information about early childcare",
  "LevelComprehensionGoodExcellentYes" = "Language proficiency",
  "PresentOrientedYes" = "Time preferences (present orientation)",
  "KnowsECIsSubsidizedYes" = "Knowledge of childcare subsidies",
  "BelieveAccessingChildcareEasyYes" = "Perceived ease of accessing childcare",
  "HasAccessToAComputerYes" = "Digital access",
  "CanAccessScoialResourcesYes" = "Access to social support resources",
  "CanAccessInformationYes" = "Access to information resources",
  "ActivityCriteriaYesYes" = "Employment-based prioritization criteria",
  "SocialCriteriaYesYes" = "Social vulnerability prioritization criteria",
  "RegistrationOnlineOnlyYes" = "Digitalization of childcare registration"
)

# Prepare the data for Oaxaca-Blinder
oaxaca_data_intention <- Oaxaca %>%
  filter(!is.na(Intention)) %>%
  mutate(
    target = as.numeric(Intention) - 1,
    Educ_bin = as.numeric(Educ == "Sup")) %>%   # Convert to binary: 1 for "Sup", 0 for "Bac"=) %>%
  select(target, Educ_bin, all_of(cleaned_variables_intention)) 


# Create formula using clean_vars with proper oaxaca syntax
formula_vars <- paste(cleaned_variables_intention, collapse = " + ")
formula_str <- paste("target ~ ", formula_vars, " | Educ_bin")
oax_formula <- as.formula(formula_str)

set.seed(124)
 # Level of comprehension creates pb
# Run Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition
oax_decomp_intention <- oaxaca(formula = oax_formula,
                     data = oaxaca_data_intention,
                     R = 100)  # Number of bootstrap repetitions

```

```{r}
ExplainedIntentionRFE <- plot_top_contributors(oax_decomp_intention,
                                               model = "Random Forests with RFE", 
                                               var_labels = coef_names, 
                                               top_n = 5 )
ExplainedIntentionRFE
```

```{r}


# Prepare the data for Oaxaca-Blinder
oaxaca_data_application <- Oaxaca %>%
  filter(!is.na(ECSApp)) %>%
  mutate(
    target = as.numeric(ECSApp),
    Educ_bin = as.numeric(Educ == "Sup")) %>%   # Convert to binary: 1 for "Sup", 0 for "Bac"=) %>%
  select(target, Educ_bin, all_of(cleaned_variables_application))  

# Create formula using clean_vars with proper oaxaca syntax
formula_vars <- paste(cleaned_variables_application, collapse = " + ")
formula_str <- paste("target ~ ", formula_vars, " | Educ_bin")
oax_formula <- as.formula(formula_str)

set.seed(124)
# Run Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition
oax_decomp_app <- oaxaca(formula = oax_formula,
                     data = oaxaca_data_application,
                     R = 100)  # Number of bootstrap repetition décomp agrégée
#round(oax_decomp_intention$twofold$overall[, c(1,2,4)], 3)# 3 and 5 are SD

# Diff -0.14 : coeff A (low) : 0.73; B : 0.88
# 0: low SES 
# -0.17



#plot(oax_decomp_intention, decomposition = "twofold", group.weight = -2) # weighted 



set.seed(124)


# Plot the share of the gap explained by the variables
gapExplained <- plot_oaxaca_gap(oax_decomp_app, model = "Random Forest with RFE", outcome = "Application")
gapExplained

```

```{r}
# We use other variables for Access in the main paper

oaxaca_data_access <- Oaxaca_Access %>%
  filter(!is.na(ECSUseYes)) %>%
  mutate(
    target = as.numeric(ECSUseYes),
    Educ_bin = as.numeric(Educ == "Sup"),
    Applied = factor(ifelse(ECSApp == 1, "Yes", "No" )) )%>%   # Convert to binary: 1 for "Sup", 0 for "Bac"=) %>%
  select(target, Educ_bin, all_of(cleaned_variables_access))    

# Create formula using clean_vars with proper oaxaca syntax
formula_vars <- paste(cleaned_variables_access, collapse = " + ")
formula_str <- paste("target ~ ", formula_vars, " | Educ_bin")
oax_formula <- as.formula(formula_str)

set.seed(124)
# Run Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition
oax_decomp_access <- oaxaca(formula = oax_formula,
                     data = oaxaca_data_access,
                     R = 100)  # Number of bootstrap repetitions

# Plot the share of the gap explained by the variables 
gapExplained_access <- plot_oaxaca_gap(oax_decomp_access, 
                                       outcome = "Access", 
                                       model = "Random Forest with RFE")
gapExplained_access 
```
